introHtml: Hooded nursing scrubs offer extra warmth and a modern silhouette for healthcare professionals who work in cooler environments or need additional pocket space. Unlike standard scrub tops, the hood adds a casual layer that can be removed or tucked away when not needed. Perfect for hospital staff, lab teams, or medical students who want a comfortable, branded uniform that stands out. Decorate with embroidery or screen printing for a polished look.
